name: Jossith Quillic
keeps: the route, which is not written down
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: His life story opens with him using sorcery for revenge and spends the rest of itself on the consequences.
text: Jossith quillic of the open ledger, carries between for the 20th tranche, doors 181 to 190. Keeps the route, which is not written down. Reads Milarepa.
